sourceTexts: Manchester United are waiting for Barcelona to decide whether to activate the agreed transfer option before the deadline. The player remains under contract at Old Trafford.
validCaption: We have seen enough uncertain exits to know this cannot drift all summer. The confirmed position is simple: United are waiting for Barcelona's decision, and our recruitment planning needs clarity either way. For us, the real question is whether the club has already prepared the right football solution if the move does not happen. Should United force an early decision or keep the door open until the deadline? #MUFC #ManchesterUnited #RedDevils #Transfers
